officialTitle: International Adjuvant Lung Cancer Trial: cisplatin-based adjuvant chemotherapy in completely resected NSCLC

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: A total of 1867 patients underwent randomization
design.notes: Each centre pre-specified eligible pathological stages, cisplatin dose, partner drug and postoperative radiotherapy policy.

clinicalQuestion: Does cisplatin-based adjuvant chemotherapy improve survival after complete resection of NSCLC?

pico.population: Completely resected NSCLC, pathological stage I to III
pico.intervention: Three or four cycles of cisplatin-based doublet chemotherapy (partner drug chosen per centre)

arms.label: Cisplatin-based chemotherapy
arms.regimen: Cisplatin plus etoposide, vinorelbine, vinblastine or vindesine (centre choice), three or four cycles

publications.title: Cisplatin-based adjuvant chemotherapy in patients with completely resected non-small-cell lung cancer.
publications.label: Primary analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: Patients assigned to chemotherapy had a significantly higher survival rate than those assigned to observation (44.5 percent vs. 40.4 percent at five years [469 deaths vs. 504]; hazard ratio for death, 0.86; 95 percent confidence interval, 0.76 to 0.98; P<0.03).

Patients assigned to chemotherapy also had a significantly higher disease-free survival rate than those assigned to observation (39.4 percent vs. 34.3 percent at five years [518 events vs. 577]; hazard ratio, 0.83; 95 percent confidence interval, 0.74 to 0.94; P<0.003).

safety.sourceQuote: Seven patients (0.8 percent) died of chemotherapy-induced toxic effects.

strengths: Large randomised trial with OS as primary endpoint
limitations: Heterogeneous partner drugs, cisplatin doses and radiotherapy policies across centres

clinicalImplications.text: Established cisplatin-based adjuvant chemotherapy as a survival-improving option after complete resection of NSCLC, a foundation later reinforced by the LACE pooled analysis.

tumourBoardPearl.text: IALT was the first large modern trial to show an OS benefit for adjuvant cisplatin doublets; the benefit is real but modest, so fitness for cisplatin matters.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 14736927. Longer-term follow-up not ingested.
